newsitem.title: USA: Safety-Kleen sees Q1 EPS down.
newsitem.headline: Safety-Kleen sees Q1 EPS down.

text.p: Safety-Kleen Corp said Tuesday it expects first quarter earnings of about $0.20 a share, down from $0.23 a share a year ago.
Added capacity in the lube oil industry in North America is pressuring lube oil selling prices more than expected, the company said.

"The company expects that its Oil Recovery Service will generate a net loss of approximately $1 million in the first quarter compared with net earnings of $860,000 in the first quarter of 1996," chief executive John Johnson Jr. said in a news release.
The company also said it deferred the planned expansion of its East Chicago re-refinery due to the weak lube oil market.
The environmental and industrial service company said it expects its other services will produce strong revenue growth during the rest of the year.
